trend_radar.description: Know what's trending and rising in a domain

opportunity_discovery.description: Find viable product/tool opportunities from developer activity
opportunity_discovery.stop_condition: opportunities.json ready + report rendered + min hypothesis confidence >= 0.7

hypothesis_validation.description: Confirm or refute a specific hypothesis

collect.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run builderdna collect {domain} --window {window} --output output/signals.json
collect.description: Collect GitHub signals (repos + issues) for a domain

trend.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run builderdna trend agent --data output/signals.json --output output/trends.json
trend.description: Compute topic trends from collected signals

pain.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run builderdna pain agent --data output/signals.json --output output/pain_clusters.json
pain.description: Mine pain points from issue text (requires Ollama)

opportunity.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run builderdna opportunity --trends output/trends.json --pains output/pain_clusters.json --output output/opportunities.json
opportunity.description: Generate opportunity cards from trends + pain clusters

report.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run builderdna report --data {data_file} --format md
report.description: Render any SandboxResult to Markdown or JSON
